evals.name: compress-claude-md
evals.prompt:
this CLAUDE.md got way too long and claude seems to ignore half of it. shorten it without losing anything that matters.

# Project rules

IMPORTANT: You are a senior full-stack engineer with 20 years of experience. Always write clean, maintainable, high-quality code.

## Package manager
We use pnpm. Always use pnpm. Never use npm or yarn. If you see npm in docs, use pnpm instead. Remember: pnpm only!

## Secrets
NEVER commit .env files. Never commit secrets. Do not ever add .env or any file with API keys to git. This is very important.

## Database
Do not run anything against the production database. The prod DB url is in PROD_DATABASE_URL; never use it. Use the local docker db (pnpm db:up) for all work.

## Code style
Write clean code. Use meaningful variable names. Keep functions small. Follow best practices. Use TypeScript. Prefer const over let. Use async/await instead of callbacks. Add comments where needed. Make sure code is readable.

## Testing
Always write tests. Run tests after every change. Double check that tests pass. Make sure all tests pass before finishing. Run pnpm test.

## Process
Think step by step. Plan before coding. Explain your reasoning. Be thorough. Don't be lazy. Before every edit read README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

## Communication
Be concise. Be clear. Don't be verbose. Get to the point.
